name: hydrotrack
description: A fully self-contained hydroponic tower manager. No build step, no internet connection required, no CDNs. Everything needed to run it is already inside this folder.

scripts.sync-www: cmd /c "robocopy . www *.html *.css *.js *.json *.png *.jpg *.svg /S /XD node_modules android .git .vscode .gemini www /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /nc /ns /np & exit /b 0"
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
